purpose: Six separately drawn supplemental poses per clip, interleaved with the six retained original key poses.

source_layout.loop_seam: Idle/walk new5 bridges original5 to original0. One-shot new5 is the settled final follow-through; defeat stays prone.
source_layout.sampling: Nonuniform source spacing is calibrated with explicit regions and transparent atlas margins. Whole-new-bank proportional scale is allowed to match the retained original model; no per-frame resizing or generated runtime in-betweens.

provenance_policy: All packaged PNGs are byte-identical image_gen outputs. Existing six-frame source sheets remain unchanged. Original and revised generated outputs remain in /workspace/generated_images. Python was used only for read-only alpha/size/hash analysis and this metadata file; no programmatic image editing, recoloring, frame warps or crossfades were used to create poses.
revision_focus: Draw intermediate leg/arm/weapon articulation while preserving existing original keyframes.
Separate full figures and blades with real transparent source gutters.
Correct conspicuous head/torso width and color differences from the original model.
Compare actual chronological twelve-frame gameplay renderings during review.
limitations: One front three-quarter viewing direction with runtime horizontal mirroring.
Hand-painted poses can have small natural silhouette variations.
Source rows and columns require calibration metadata rather than equal-grid slicing.

review.rendering: Actual Godot arena actor drawing, 12 chronological frames per clip, six clips per hero; original even frames interleaved with generated odd frames.
accepted_findings: Conspicuous alternating wide/narrow head and torso differences corrected.
Ground placement stable at actual gameplay scale.
Attack blades complete and isolated from neighboring source poses.
Walk, dodge, hurt and defeat sequences read in chronological order.
Small natural hand-painted silhouette differences remain acceptable.
review.original_preservation: All three retained original PNG SHA-256 values independently rechecked against the previous hero_provenance.json; unchanged.
